page.notes: The first line of the left column and the last of the right are cut at the page edges. The number "136" at the top of the right column is probably the number of the last left-column entry ("rerum naturæ instar numerorum se habent"), which carries no number on this scan; it is kept as its own line. The Greek entries ῥοπὴ and ἀγροῖκοι are read from a small print and may be imperfect. "verę" (res à Deo conditæ) is doubtful. "ꝯmunes" is written with the con- abbreviation as printed.
